title: Spa Metric1 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spa:metric1
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often spa metric1 (1) events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on spa metric1 (1) events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It catches how often your spa metric1 (1) exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
